enriched_description: Coffee brewing device that forces pressurized steam through finely ground coffee. Construction is aluminum or stainless steel (polished or brushed finish). Moka pot variant: octagonal or round stacked chambers (lower water reservoir, middle filter basket, upper collection chamber) with threaded connection and black Bakelite handle. Height 15-25 cm. Pump espresso machine: box-shaped body with portafilter (metal handle with basket), steam wand (curved metal tube), and drip tray. Pressure gauge (circular dial) on front. Control knobs or buttons for brewing and steam. Surface shows metallic sheen with heat-resistant plastic components.

Cosmetic powder product in compact or loose form. Compact: round or square plastic/metal case (8-10 cm diameter) with hinged lid, mirror inside lid, and pressed powder pan. Powder surface is smooth, flat disc in skin-tone shades (ivory, beige, tan, porcelain) or translucent. Texture is finely milled, matte or satin finish. Loose powder: cylindrical container with sifter top (perforated disc), powder flows through holes. Packaging features brand labeling, shade name, and decorative graphics. Powder consistency is dry, silky, easily disturbed. Applicator puff or brush may be included.

Long scarf-like accessory (length 180-250 cm) constructed from rows of feathers attached to central cord or fabric base. Feathers are marabou, ostrich, or turkey plumes in various colors (black, white, red, pink, blue, or multicolored). Feather density creates voluminous, fluffy appearance. Width when fluffed is 15-25 cm. Feathers exhibit natural barbs and soft texture, creating undulating surface. Attachment points along length are concealed. End tips may be tapered or uniform. Overall form is tubular when worn, draping loosely around neck and shoulders.

Office storage furniture with multiple drawers for document filing. Construction is sheet metal (steel) or wood. Metal variant: rectangular box (45x65x70 cm for 4-drawer lateral) with smooth painted surface (gray, black, beige, or putty). Drawers slide on metal runners, each with label holder on front face. Handle is recessed pull or protruding bar. Lock mechanism (central or per-drawer) with key. Drawer interior has hanging file rails. Wood variant shows furniture-style finish with decorative hardware. Surface is smooth with slight texture from paint or wood grain.

Specialized vessel equipped for firefighting on water. Hull is sturdy construction (steel or aluminum) with high freeboard. Deck features prominent water cannons (monitor nozzles) mounted on bow and amidships, capable of 360-degree rotation. Water cannons are large-diameter metal pipes with directional nozzles. Pumping equipment visible on deck. Superstructure includes wheelhouse with large windows for visibility. Color scheme is red (fire service) or white with red markings. Hose reels, deck hydrants, and foam systems visible. Length 15-50 meters. Wake shows powerful propulsion for rapid response.

Large emergency vehicle with red (or yellow) painted body, emergency light bar on roof, and reflective striping. Cab-over or conventional cab configuration. Body features compartments (roll-up doors) housing hoses, tools, and equipment. Pump panel on side or rear with gauges, valves, and hose connections. Hose bed on top with folded fire hoses. Ladder may be mounted on top (aerial ladder truck variant shows extended telescoping ladder). Emergency lights: rotating beacons, LED light bars, and scene lights. Siren speaker on front bumper. Dimensions: 8-12 m long, 2.5 m wide.

Metal mesh or perforated panel positioned in front of fireplace opening. Frame is wrought iron, brass, or steel with decorative elements (scrollwork, finials, or geometric patterns). Screen panel is fine wire mesh (black or dark finish) allowing heat radiation while blocking sparks. Dimensions: width 60-100 cm, height 50-80 cm. Support is folding legs (3-panel screen) or fixed feet. Handle or ring on top for repositioning. Surface texture is smooth metal frame with grid-pattern mesh. Decorative variants show ornate cast iron details, polished brass accents, or painted finishes.

Tall vertical pole (height 5-30+ meters) for displaying flags. Material is aluminum (silver, smooth), fiberglass (white or tan), or wood (natural grain). Cross-section is tapered (wider at base, narrower at top) or uniform. Top features truck (pulley assembly) with halyard (rope) for raising/lowering flag. Base has cleat for securing halyard and ground sleeve or bracket mount. Surface is smooth with visible seams (aluminum extrusion) or natural texture (wood). Gold ball or eagle finial may cap the top. Flag attachment points are snap hooks on halyard.

Woodwind instrument consisting of slender cylindrical tube (length 66-67 cm) with closed end and embouchure hole. Body is silver, gold, or nickel-silver with polished or matte finish. Key mechanism covers tone holes along length, with padded cups and rod-and-lever system. Keys are arranged in Boehm system pattern. Headjoint is separate piece with lip plate and embouchure hole (oval opening). Footjoint extends lower range. Body sections (headjoint, body, footjoint) connect with tenon joints. Surface shows key posts, adjustment screws, and engraved maker's mark. Overall form is straight, held horizontally.

Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.
